PUBLIC SPACE / VERSION 1

A browser-native computer interface built for Donovan Martinez by OpenAI Codex.

C64 Pro Mono font by STYLE, used under its font embedding/software package license. The original font is unmodified.

The screen has 40 columns and 25 rows with C64-style borders, colors, and glyphs. The old RAM message is visual homage, not a real memory benchmark.

The BASIC interpreter is original project code. It does not emulate a 6510 CPU, VIC-II, SID, a disk drive, or Commodore ROMs. It cannot run downloaded binary PRG or D64 files.

The project source follows the repository's existing GNU GPL version 2 license. The font has its own separate license. No warranty. See the repository for source and license terms.

Saved programs stay in your browser. EXPORT downloads their source. The site does not upload your programs.
